value.rationale: Completes the natural nilpotency-index/domain-rank census for all graphs with at least three arbitrary partite classes; previous work covers square-zero and the two-part boundary only. The rook-poset structure handles nontrivial part-cycle constraints and the capacity envelope yields a sharp spanning-chain criterion and exact cardinality. This is a complete infinite-family semigroup invariant, not an arbitrary slice or numerically motivated example.
